releaseNotes: 20.4.0: expanded NEXUS WORLD from six to nine explorable cosmic sectors, adding the Quantum Rift, Nebula Garden and Echo Citadel with new lore, artifacts, unlock costs and expeditions. Preserved existing six-sector saves, five levelled base buildings, eight research nodes, local economy, archive and backup system. Also repairs the expansion module's missing local data resource and refreshes offline caching.
